text:
maya: Heads-up: comping a decision doc for the console/observability roadmap next quarter. We need a firm MVP that balances customer asks (ACME, Beta) with engineering risk. Key asks: per-route spend, cheaper tracing for hotpaths, error grouping by model version. Can we converge on must-haves vs cuts by Friday?

samir: From infra: focus on accuracy of attribution and safety of sampling. Proposed must-haves: - cost summary per-route (top 10) - tracing hook that can be toggled per-route with a sampling cap - grouped errors with model-version tag. Everything else is stretch.

elaine: Instrumentation notes: we can wire trace hooks into the ingestion pipeline in one sprint, but sampling controls + UI will take two. If we need to cut scope, drop per-model breakdown at launch and expose model info in raw trace details only.

nick: Customers also asked for CSV export and Prometheus metrics for operational KPIs. CSV is low lift once the metrics table exists; Prometheus hooks are a separate infra ticket. Recommend CSV as stretch, prometheus as post-launch.

maya: Draft launch criteria (must): 1) cost numbers within 10% of billing for sampled traffic, 2) trace hooks active for the top-3 customer routes, 3) error groups include stack + model-version and link to traces. Rollback condition: if dashboard query latency > 500ms or cost attribution delta > 20%.

samir: Rollout plan: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Sampling guardrails: global sampling budget per-customer and per-route limit to avoid runaway ingestion. Add alerting for sudden cost spikes or error-rate regressions.

elaine: Suggested sampling config schema (first pass):
```json
{"route": "string", "target_p50_ms": 200, "sampling_rate": 0.05, "max_traces_per_min": 200}
```
We'll ship a tiny UI to toggle a handful of routes + CLI for bulk edits.

nick: Dashboard MVP widgets: cost-overview, top-10 routes by spend, error-trend sparkline, recent-sampled-traces list. Stretch: CSV export, per-model breakdown, dashboard theming.

maya: Ops asks: add an acceptance test: ingest at peak X traces/min and ensure UI query latency <300ms for filtered views. Also show a customer story in the doc: ACME lost visibility into a spike last week because sampling was global; per-route sampling would've saved ~2 hours of debug.

samir: Also call out quotas: default sampling budget per-org, with an opt-in for higher budgets for Dedicated customers. That ties into pricing.

elaine: Estimates coming into tracker now. Trimmed MVP is 2-3 sprints depending on overlap with current telemetry work.

maya: OK scheduling a 30m decision huddle Thursday 15:00 to finalize. Please paste any direct ACME/Beta quotes here so I can cite them in the exec doc. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary deploy for obs-trace-hooks initiated on infra-canary-5 (build 2026.42) :rocket:

samir: quick addition: include an acceptance checklist item for data fidelity: sampled vs unsampled token counts must be within 5% distribution for top routes. Otherwise cost balancing will be misleading.

elaine: noted. adding tests for fidelity and query perf.

maya: thanks team. If nobody objects by EOD Friday we'll lock these as the launch gates and publish the decision doc.
